lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast white vertical line segments traversing the torso, with relatively uniform spacing that narrows slightly toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line is abbreviated and terminates mid-torso; the posterior-most vertical lines transition into fragmented segments and spots toward the lower haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-density cluster of approximately 8 to 10 distinct white spots situated on the lateral posterior haunch, located inferior to the primary vertical lines.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of three distinct spots on the mid-posterior haunch forming a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white patch on the lower neck; two distinct white spots on the face (one sub-orbital and one on the lower cheek area); white 'sock' markings on the lower limbs.
